hooks.prompt: Check if this project has a .codex/config.toml file. If it is missing and Codex functionality is needed, ask the user for confirmation before creating or modifying project files.
Before using Codex MCP tools, verify that .codex/config.toml exists in the project. If it is missing, ask for user confirmation before bootstrapping configuration files.

After Codex execution, check if a threadId was returned in the response. If so, note it for potential follow-up queries using mcp__codex-native__codex-reply. Also review the output for any errors or warnings that should be reported to the user.
